answer: Each identity must buy one dawn slot in the echo ledger: the first slot from a funder costs 20 credits, and each next slot from the same funder doubles, so fake k pays 20 times 2 to the power k minus 1. Ten fakes cost 20,460 credits; a hundred cost about 2.5e31, beyond any emission. Each slot is carved on one shale tablet that cannot be split, so clones cannot pool the price.
